name: Shiva amygdala signal (fast, 3x)
origin: Shiva software by Todd Murphy (signal templates licensed from Persinger and Koren)
summary: Murphy's simple Shiva amygdala session with the signal played three times faster, stepped counter-clockwise around the head. The vendor says 'fast speeds the signal up by three times, a configuration that elicited fewer phenomenal effects', and presents the amygdala signal for emotional effects. The waveform is rebuilt from a description.
notes: The vendor: 'fast speeds the signal up by three times, a configuration that elicited fewer phenomenal effects' (amygdala_page.htm). The signal is documented with 289 points of 3 ms (Saroka 2010 p.5 [470]; Collins 2014 p.40 [31]). The normal-speed session was run in the lab with 4 s between cycles and 100 ms on the first position plus 20 ms more on each next one (Collins 2014 p.40 [31]); other lab runs stepped 20 to 6 ms and 100 to 30 ms (Saroka 2010 p.5 [470]). This file plays this project's rising sweep with that length at 1-ms points: a 289-ms burst sweeping 18 to 90 Hz, then 1.33 s of silence. The point values were never published as numbers. Whether the fast version also shortens the silence or changes the step table is not stated; the 1.33-s silence is this project's choice. Coils sit on the vendor's Shiva ring (Fp1, FT7, TP7, O1, O2, TP8, FT8, Fp2) and fire one at a time, counter-clockwise seen from above. Shiva has a coil pair at each position; one coil keeps the timing and covers about half the arc. The step of 10, 12 ... 20 ms per coil is this project's reading of a lecture example with no unit named (Murphy lecture 19:42-19:53), not a lab table; the fast session's own table is not published. The vendor gives no number for Shiva's field. This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT that is about 24 uT at the scalp. The vendor's advice to 'change to a frontal lobe presentation' cannot be followed on a fixed ring. The effect is a vendor claim. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Phase 1 alone is the 20-min version; with phase 2 it is the 30-min one. Not for people with epilepsy; stop if distressed.
setting: Dark, quiet room, eyes closed, relaxed without meditating or falling asleep. Shiva offers 20, 30 and 60-min versions; start with the short one.
schedule: At most once a week, never on consecutive days; up to 6 sessions, then a 21-day break. 60-min sessions weekly or every two weeks at most.
